title: Route Gourmet
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Want to discover Quebec City differently, far off the beaten track? Embark on our electric rickshaw and let yourself be transported by a passionate Driver-Guide through the most authentic and gourmet areas of the city. From the Place Royale to the Nouvo Saint-Roch, the Old Limoilou, and the Grand Point of Sale in Quebec City, each stop reveals a different side of local history and culture — effortless, traffic-free, just you, the breeze and a Guide who knows all the best corners. It is a friendly, ecological and unique way to live Quebec, whether you are a couple, friends or family. Book your seat now and let yourself be surprised by a city you already thought you knew!
